author_notes: Forest Slope 1K RGBE panorama by Andreas Mischok, Poly Haven CC0; exact upstream bytes and hashes are recorded in forest_slope_1k.source.json. Its all-zero PRIMARIES are explicitly interpreted as Rec709 linear under the authored source policy. Forest canopy supplies the photographed environment; the engine's directional light remains the separate direct-light source and no procedural sun disk is added. Bake outputs preserve scene-linear radiance without exposure or display transfer.
